description: This Java class provides a simple implementation of audio output using Android's AudioTrack API. It manages the creation, starting, stopping, and data writing to an audio track for PCM float audio data, primarily for experimental or educational purposes within a MIDI synthesizer context.

classes.name: SimpleAudioOutput
classes.description: A class to facilitate basic audio output functionality using Android's AudioTrack, including methods to start, create, write data to, and stop audio playback.

methods.name: SimpleAudioOutput
methods.description: Constructor default initializer for the SimpleAudioOutput class.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts audio playback at a specified frame rate.

methods.name: createAudioTrack
methods.description: Creates and configures an AudioTrack instance with appropriate buffer sizes based on the frame rate.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes PCM float buffer data to the AudioTrack for playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops audio playback and releases the AudioTrack resource.

methods.name: getFrameRate
methods.description: Returns the current frame rate used for audio output.
